grades.quote: With the block map approach, the file system would need to do at least two disk read operations: one to read the single indirect block and one to read the data blocks.

grades.quote: For larger files, these file systems keep the inodes compact by using indirect blocks, roughly analogous to multilevel page tables.
grades.reason: Directly explains that larger files use indirect blocks when their block-address arrays cannot remain in compact inodes.
